title: Divide Chocolate
summary: Given a chocolate bar with chunks having individual sweetness values in an array, divide the bar into k+1 pieces with k cuts.
statement: Given a chocolate bar with chunks having individual sweetness values in an array, divide the bar into k+1 pieces with k cuts. Determine the optimal cutting strategy to maximize the minimum total sweetness of your piece.
constraints: Cut the positive array into k+1 nonempty contiguous pieces.
You keep the piece with the smallest total sweetness.
Maximize the sweetness you can guarantee for that smallest piece.
hints: Greedily cut a piece whenever its running sum first reaches the candidate.
The candidate is feasible when this creates at least k+1 pieces.
Positive values make earliest cuts maximize the remaining material, and feasibility is monotone.
editorial: Positive values make earliest cuts maximize the remaining material, and feasibility is monotone.

tests.explanation: Six pieces can each reach at least six, but not seven.
Nine pieces means every element stands alone, so the minimum is one.
